Itemized Passive Description:
*Basic effect(s)*
- "Corroded Body and Mind" Category or PHY Type allies' Ki +3
- Ki +1 and ATK & DEF 20%{passiveImg:up_g} for allies whose names include
"Baby" or "Possessed"
*Per "Corroded Body and Mind" Category ally on the team*
- ATK & DEF 50%{passiveImg:up_g}
*When there is an ally whose name includes "Baby" attacking in
the same turn*
- Changes Ki Spheres: PHY to STR
- ATK & DEF 100%{passiveImg:up_g}
- Chance of evading enemy's attack & damage reduction rate 20%{passiveImg:up_g}
- Guards all attacks
*When attacking with 12 or more Ki*
- ATK & DEF 200%{passiveImg:up_g}
*As the 3rd attacker in a turn, or for 1 turn from the character's
entry turn*
- Launches an additional Super Attack
- High chance of evading enemy's attack
- "Corroded Body and Mind" Category allies' ATK & DEF 10%{passiveImg:up_g}
- ATK & DEF 20%{passiveImg:up_g} and chance of evading enemy's attack 5%{passiveImg:up_g}
for allies whose names include "Baby" or "Possessed"
